nodes.description: Public token name string, initialized to 'BitEDU'.
Public token symbol string, initialized to 'BEU'.
Public token decimals value, set to 18.
Total token supply, written in constructor and reduced by burn().
Contract owner address, assigned msg.sender in constructor and used as privilege gate in burn/lock/lockForAll.
Global transfer lock flag toggled by lockForAll().
Mapping address=>uint256 holding user balances, keyed by msg.sender, _to and _from.
Mapping address=>uint256 holding frozen balances, mutated by freeze() and unfreeze().
Mapping address=>uint256 holding locked amounts, mutated by lock() and read during transfers.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint256 allowance, written by approve() and consumed by transferFrom().
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies a and b with a require-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: divides a by b after requiring b > 0.
SafeMath.safeSub: subtracts b from a after requiring b <= a.
SafeMath.safeAdd: adds a and b with a require-based overflow check.
Constructor: sets owner to msg.sender and credits the creator with the whole totalSupply.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): guarded token transfer that debits msg.sender and credits _to.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets or resets allowance for msg.sender.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): spends allowance[_from][msg.sender] and moves tokens.
freeze(uint256 _value): moves msg.sender balance into freezeOf.
unfreeze(uint256 _value): moves frozen balance of msg.sender back into balanceOf.
burn(uint256 _value): owner-only burn that reduces balanceOf[msg.sender] and totalSupply.
lock(address _to, uint256 _value): owner-only setting of lockOf[_to].
lockForAll(bool b): owner-only toggle of the global lockAll flag.
Fallback payable function that unconditionally reverts.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance keys and allowance keys.
